thread:
Elena P: Quick capture from today's AH Q&A — consolidating live asks, owners, and a short demo request list. Keeping it terse so we can action.

Ravi M: Two live asks from customers: 1) can Redwood Optimize suggest per-route quantization profiles? 2) will Optimize run offline vs in-console?

Tara V: Answer: yes to per-route suggestions, and Optimize will offer both an offline batch job and an in-console quick-scan. Docs + UX copy needed. @Maya L want to coordinate pricing blurb for offline runs?

Maya L: Yep, will draft pricing tiers for Optimize (quick-scan free, batch-run paid). Will add sample invoice line.

Owen G: Ops question in thread: can we throttle Optimize jobs to avoid impacting serving nodes? Need a scheduler/priority plan.

Elena P: Good call. Scheduler will run batch jobs on dedicated background workers and rate-limit IO to avoid noisy neighbor. Owen, can you own the queue / priority config?

Owen G: Taking it. I'll propose default limits and a toggle to move jobs to low-priority mode.

legal-bot: legal note: any Optimize feature that uploads customer prompts must include explicit consent language and opt-in checkbox. See policy 5.2.

Tara V: Product action: write consent copy + UX wire for opt-in. Also add a short FAQ blurb about data retention for Optimize snapshots.

Ravi M: Demo ask: sales wants a 5-min demo of Optimize + a canned eval showing cost savings for a sample chat app. Who can produce the deck + demo script?

Maya L: I can draft a 2-slide pricing comparison and sample invoice showing savings. Need someone to record a 5-min walkthrough or pair with sales.

Elena P: Owners summarized:
- Maya L: pricing tiers + sample invoice + demo slides
- Owen G: queue/priority config + rate limits for batch runs
- Tara V: consent copy + UX wire + FAQ blurb
- Ravi M: demo script + coordinate recording with sales

Action checklist:
- [ ] Pricing tiers + invoice example (Maya)
- [ ] Scheduler config + low-priority toggle (Owen)
- [ ] Opt-in copy + retention FAQ (Tara)
- [ ] Demo script + recording plan (Ravi)

deploy-bot: note: staging job scheduler updated in infra branch 'optimize-scheduler' (sha: f1234ab).

Elena P: Please reply with "claimed" when you pick an item. I'll assemble an announcement + demo invite once drafts are in.

Maya L: claimed 4b0 will post pricing draft link in #docs by EOD.

Owen G: claimed 680 will PR default queue limits and toggle tomorrow.

Tara V: claimed 4c4 adding opt-in copy and a short FAQ.

Ravi M: claimed 4f0 will write script and coordinate with sales for recording slot next Tue.

Elena P: Thanks team 44d. I'll publish follow-up note and add the demo RSVP once we have slides.
